title: English-only Google Ads base tag with denied-by-default Consent Mode

authority.human_request: Install Google Ads tag AW-16798915501 for the Mepatrone English rent lead funnel.
authority.authorized_for_builder_after_freeze: smallest local base-tag implementation and local verification against this exact frozen contract
unauthorized: editing this contract, freeze manifest, gate, fixtures, or baseline-red evidence
Google Ads campaign, conversion-action, billing, payment, or spend mutation
consent update or grant before an explicit consent-choice product is separately authorized
conversion event, conversion destination, or claim before Google Ads issues both conversion labels

control.candidate_subject: builder must return one exact local commit descended from the verifier freeze commit and the baseline
control.expires_on: candidate transaction completion, subject drift, gate drift, fixture drift, protected-contract drift, or execution-boundary change
approved_wrong_states: production baseline has no Google tag
Consent Mode is granted unconditionally before user choice
consent update occurs without a consent-choice product
Google tag is mounted on Georgian routes
conversion is claimed before labels exist
control.interpreter: Node.js v25.2.1 with the subject repository's scripts/ts-resolve.mjs

required_behavior: The only Google Ads account ID is exact AW-16798915501.
The Google tag loads exactly once and is mounted only by the English app route-group layout; Georgian routes receive no Google tag or Ads identifier.
Before the tag loader or gtag config executes, Consent Mode defaults ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data, and ad_personalization to denied.
No consent category is unconditionally granted and no consent update exists in this transaction. A consent choice/update flow is a separate product task.
No Google conversion event, send_to destination, conversion label, or conversion-tracking claim exists in this candidate because Google Ads has not issued the two labels.
Existing first-party wa_tap and call_tap events, listing IDs, surfaces, approved call number, and listing-specific WhatsApp URLs remain byte-identical and are not replaced by Google measurement.
The tag ID is a public measurement identifier, not a credential; no credential, phone, listing payload, raw event metadata, or debug log is added to the Google base tag.
The implementation uses Next-compatible script loading, passes the production build, and does not introduce eval, dynamic script-element creation, or dangerous inline-HTML APIs.
Existing frozen English-agent, zero-Georgian, listing-12411, image-failure, Georgian owner-direct, lint, type, and build contracts remain unchanged and green.

required_interfaces.core_module: lib/google-ads-measurement-core.ts exports only the exact GOOGLE_ADS_ID and four-key GOOGLE_CONSENT_DEFAULT authority needed by the base tag
required_interfaces.tag_component: components/EnglishGoogleAdsMeasurement.tsx uses next/script and emits denied consent before the one loader/config

builder_obligations: Do not inspect, modify, replace, or weaken verifier-owned artifacts.
Observe the exact baseline RESULT:FAIL:5/9 before implementation.
Implement only the smallest complete base-tag candidate in allowed paths.
Do not invent conversion labels and do not emit or claim any conversion event.
Keep all four Consent Mode defaults denied and add no update/grant path in this transaction.
Run the frozen gate to RESULT:PASS:9/9, the complete unit suite, eslint, tsc --noEmit, and a production build with network disabled or controlled.

Add an implementation-owned behavioral test for exact ID, denied defaults, consent-before-config order, one English mount, zero Georgian reach, and zero conversion dispatch; builder tests supplement but never replace the frozen gate.
Return the exact final local commit, changed-file hashes, commands, exit codes, and any reproducibility limitation.
Do not push, deploy, mutate Vercel or Google Ads, create campaigns/conversion actions, or spend.
independent_verification_after_build: Recheck gate, fixture, freeze, baseline-evidence, and protected-contract hashes before execution.
Run the exact gate against exact baseline and exact candidate in separate clean worktrees.
Observe all five wrong fixtures red and the honest base-tag fixture green.
Inspect only the final candidate diff after the gate verdict for hidden duplicate loaders, unconditional consent grant/update, Georgian reachability, conversion claims, or extra data sent to Google.
Run unit, eslint, type checking, and production build independently.

Before any separately authorized deployment, verify rendered desktop and 390px English pages have one tag with denied default consent and Georgian pages have none; block event/intake writes during browser verification.
After Google issues two real labels, freeze a separate conversion task for distinct wa_tap and call_tap destinations before claiming those conversions are measured.
